answer: Each identity may send its claim through the canyon only as far as its own track record reaches: one verified job of this epoch buys one step, and a clone with no record stops at the gate. A claim that carries a sable mark — a failed claim from its own past — is cut in half before it may pass, and the mark never washes off. A violet seal is stamped on claims that survive a full epoch of public scrutiny, and a faded seal — one no fresh job renewed — drops the claim outright. Ten voices need ten separate records and ten fresh renewals, because no track record can be lent to a clone.
